name: Slow-swing dual regime gate arms BB-z washout (long-hold, wide stop) reversion
rationale: THESIS: same dual macro/vix arming + bb_z washout, but expressed as a SLOW structural swing (min-hold high, max-hold long, wide stop/tp, long time-stop) rather than a tactical bounce. The bet is that in an intact risk-on calm-vol regime a washed-out major mean-reverts over weeks, not days; holding through noise harvests the full reversion and cuts turnover to near-zero (fees negligible). DISCONFIRMER 1 (does horizon matter, or is it the same trade?): the fast-bounce sibling (spec-1) is the direct horizon control; if the slow version is not better risk-adjusted, the long hold only adds path risk. DISCONFIRMER 2 (just buy-the-washout-and-hold?): ungated long-hold bb_z control. DISCONFIRMER 3 (regime active?): macro lt sibling. DISCONFIRMER 4 (holdout). The long hold makes the holdout especially load-bearing — few independent trades, so a frozen-param recent slice that stays positive is the real test of non-overfit.
catalyst: bb_z washout under a sustained risk-on calm-vol regime, held as a multi-week swing
